title: Smashed Cucumber Salad
description: This smashed cucumber salad has a spicy dressing made with rice vinegar, soy, garlic, sesame oil, and chili to make one of Chef John's favorite summer sides.
ingredients: 1.5 teaspoons kosher salt, plus more as needed

steps.text: Wrap each cucumber in plastic wrap to minimize splattering. Place on a work surface and pound with a flat object (like a meat pounder) until cucumbers crack and are slightly flattened. Remove from plastic. Cut cucumbers in half; halve each side lengthwise. Slice into 1- to 1 ½ -inch wide slices. Transfer to a strainer set over a bowl.
Sprinkle cucumber with salt and sugar; mix until well combined. Refrigerate the bowl and strainer for 30 to 60 minutes so cucumber pieces can drain into the bowl.
To make the dressing: Place garlic, seasoned rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes in a large bowl; whisk together thoroughly.
Transfer drained cucumbers into the bowl with dressing. Toss to coat. Cover with plastic wrap. If you have time, refrigerate salad to allow flavors to mingle, about 30 minutes.
When ready to serve, spoon crushed cucumbers into a serving bowl and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

video.description: You’ll be a smashing success when you bring this addictively good salad to the barbecue or potluck. All you need to do is cover cucumbers with plastic wrap and smash with whatever you like, which will draw out better flavor into your salad. Cut the results into smaller pieces, then mix with sugar and salt to draw liquid out of the cukes. Then toss with a dressing of crushed garlic, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and red pepper flakes. Garnish with sesame seeds and serve with ribs or other good things from your grill!
